text: bought the Aurora X2 recently. Honestly, the thing that blew my mind and exceeded my expectations was the sound. The bass feels very resonant deep and the highs are crisp. Then I also think its a really good pair to use for everyday listening. The ANC cancels out surrounding noise quite well which is great for commuting. Battery is almost 30 hours on one charge, I didn't even fully charge them yet but it should be 24-30 hours. The earcups become a bit uncomfortable on longer listening sessions or they are too tight so I think it will improve for me with time as its new and tight. The companion app will always disconnect so its not too convenient. But 149 dollar range is a pretty good price point. So I would recommend for daily use
